public_rationale: This sentence is a methodological argument: without empirical studies of collateral damage, we cannot know whether military AI helps or hurts. It names no event, deadline or threshold. Whether we 'really know' depends on evidence standards he did not specify. Whether the military has done such studies is also undocumented, so the condition's status is unknown. CENTCOM's own statement that it cannot tell which strikes used AI fits his point, but it cannot settle it. The claim cannot be scored as true or false.
limitations: A reviewer could read it as a testable forecast if a credible study of AI's net effect appeared. None was found.
